source: pathmode-corpus simulations/hartwell/grading/truth-summary.md and the truth database (schema truth in the grader's database)

problems.name: Order-entry errors that reach the customer
problems.mechanism: Hand-keyed order lines (email, phone, counter) carry keying errors (wrong item, quantity or ship-to); about 80% are caught before shipping, the rest cause returns. EDI and web orders have none. The counter's return reason codes are random with respect to the cause.
problems.shows_in: erp returns and credit memos against hand-keyed orders by channel
problems.truth: 6,447 errors reached the customer over ten years; 6,437 returns credited $3,281,327

problems.name: Pricing drift by rep
problems.mechanism: Account managers give discounts beyond each customer's agreed discount; nine 'loose' reps give 2.5-5.3% extra on average.
problems.shows_in: invoice or order line prices against list price and the customer's agreed discount, by rep
problems.truth: $24.7M given beyond agreed discounts over the decade (1.69% of revenue), most of it by the nine loose reps

problems.name: Shipments never billed
problems.mechanism: A line dropped when the invoice was keyed, or a counter pickup never rung up.
problems.shows_in: shipped lines (warehouse movements or order lines) with no invoice line

problems.name: Supplier bills that don't match the PO and the receipt
problems.mechanism: Duplicate bills (vendor invoice number with an '-R' suffix, later date), quantities above received, prices above the PO, freight not on the PO; accounts payable catches about a third.
problems.shows_in: vendor bills and lines against purchase orders and goods receipts
problems.truth: $8,765,749 overpaid over ten years: duplicates $2.75M, freight $2.45M, quantity $2.44M, price $1.13M

problems.name: Repeat where's-my-order contacts
problems.mechanism: Customers call or email about backorders (short lines), special-order waits and invoice questions; none is linked to its order in the CRM.
problems.shows_in: crm service contacts, their notes and minutes, against orders with short lines or special orders
problems.truth: 212,047 contacts, 19,085 staff hours over ten years (backorder 102,707, invoice question 55,273, special order 54,067)

problems.name: Stock-outs alongside excess stock
problems.mechanism: The buyer forecasts without a seasonal index (spring stock-outs recur) and ignores discontinued dates, so equipment retired by efficiency standards and the 2025 refrigerant change keeps being bought, then marked down; short lines go unfilled while other branches have stock.
problems.shows_in: short order lines, transfers, stock movements, purchase orders and markdowns by product and branch
problems.truth: 186,712 lines short at the branch, 122,649 filled by transfer

problems.name: Customers who pay late, by habit
problems.mechanism: Each customer has a payment habit: prompt, late (about 11 days past due) or slow (about 40 days).
problems.shows_in: payments against invoice due dates, by customer
